description: Small, deterministic starting set for measuring whether OMF context and failure memory improve coding-agent work.

tasks.prompt: Extend the recall report without breaking legacy recall-hits.jsonl records. Add a regression test for mixed legacy and structured events.
Add a machine-checkable ontology constraint to a high-risk domain and verify that the guard emits a warning for a matching edit without blocking the tool.
success_criteria: A matching edit produces a warning
The original tool input is passed through

tasks.prompt: Preserve the next action and evidence when a long-running session is compacted, without duplicating continuity packets on repeated compactions.
success_criteria: Repeated compaction replaces rather than duplicates the packet
The session hook remains safe with empty state
